chat.button: Shot ideas: a concept and ready prompts for a whole shoot

researchDays.label: Keep a topic search, days
researchDays.help: A search for the same topic is used again for this many days, so you do not pay twice. 0 means search every time.

modal.title: Shot ideas
modal.text: Describe what you are shooting. The model comes up with one shoot: a short concept and a ready prompt for every frame. Any prompt can be changed before drawing.

fields.brandPlaceholder: Name, what it is, what sets it apart
fields.wantPlaceholder: For example, the new serum on a bathroom shelf
fields.count: How many frames in the shoot
fields.countHint: These are frames of one shoot, not separate ideas. Up to {max}.
fields.audiencePlaceholder: For example, women 25–40 who care about their skin
fields.platformPlaceholder: Instagram, a marketplace, a site, ads…
fields.ideaPlaceholder: If you already have something in mind
fields.requirementsPlaceholder: What must be in the frame and what must not
fields.languageHint: The concept name and the frame names are written in it. The prompts themselves are in English: picture models understand it best.

pictures.productHint: The model looks at them to see what is being shot.
pictures.productNote: What to take from these pictures
pictures.productNotePlaceholder: For example, the bottle shape and the label
pictures.visualHint: The model takes the mood, light and colour from them, not the objects.
pictures.visualNote: What to take from these pictures
pictures.visualNotePlaceholder: For example, the soft morning light

scene.hint: Pick where the frames are shot and how they are lit. If nothing is picked, the model chooses itself.
scene.hintFilled: Every frame is built around this place and light.
scene.rollHint: Free, no AI: one thing on each line, all going well together.

surface.name: Surface
surface.hint: What the subject stands on, and what that surface does to the light.

backdrop.name: Backdrop
backdrop.hint: What is behind it, near or far.

light.name: Light
light.hint: Where the light comes from and how hard it is.

camera.name: Camera
camera.hint: Where the camera stands and how much of the subject it takes.

atmosphere.name: Atmosphere
atmosphere.hint: What hangs in the air or sits on the surfaces: water, dust, smoke, frost.

props.name: Props
props.hint: Two at most, or the frame turns into a shop window.

palette.name: Palette
palette.hint: The colours the whole frame is held to.

state.name: State
state.hint: What the product itself is doing at the moment the shutter opens.

options.research: Look up the niche in Google first
options.researchHint: A short search of what is shot in this niche now. The ideas take it into account.
options.researchCached: Already found on {date}: used again for free.
options.drawFirst: Draw the first frame at once
options.drawFirstHint: With this chat's picture settings. The other frames wait until you accept the first one.
options.productToFrames: Put the product pictures into the frames
options.productToFramesHint: Every drawn frame gets the product pictures as references.

card.researching: Looking up the niche in Google…
card.stopAsk: Stop writing the ideas? What is already paid stays paid.
card.research: What Google found about the niche
card.researchFailed: The search did not work, so the ideas were written without it.
card.researchEnglish: Written in English: this text is for the model.
card.promptPlaceholder: What has to be in this frame
card.drawAllHint: The first frame is drawn now, the others after you accept it. The whole series: {usd}.
card.rerollAsk: Replace your words in frame {n} with a new idea?
card.drawFailed: The first frame was not drawn.
card.sceneEmpty: Nothing picked, the model chose itself

errors.ideas_niche_empty: Write the niche: what the shoot is about.
errors.ideas_bad_count: Wrong number of frames. Pick one from the list.
errors.ideas_bad_language: The names can be written in Russian, Ukrainian or English only.
errors.ideas_too_many_pictures: Too many pictures in one group. Remove a few.
errors.ideas_not_a_picture: One of the files is not a picture. Remove it and try again.
errors.ideas_scene_unknown: One of the picked places or lights is unknown. Clear the tab and pick again.
errors.ideas_card_unknown: This frame is not in the set any more.
errors.ideas_not_ready: The ideas are not written yet. Wait until they are.
errors.ideas_prompt_empty: The frame has no prompt. Write one first.
errors.ideas_nothing_to_draw: There is nothing to draw: every frame is empty.
errors.ideas_busy: A new idea for a frame is already being written. Wait for it.
errors.ideas_empty: The model answered, but there was not a single frame in that answer. Try again, or make the brief simpler.
